speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me understand your condition, how long have these symptoms been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. You mentioned recent travel, hiking, and camping along with multiple illnesses; have you noticed any specific triggers for your fatigue, such as fever, muscle aches, or exposure to ticks or insects?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

The combination of fatigue worsening later in the day and mild diplopia (double vision) is classic for Myasthenia Gravis, an autoimmune neuromuscular junction disorder. I am requesting images of your eyes to confirm the diplopia and assess for ptosis.
